name: tech.augmenta.unity-ws-client
description: Receive data from an Augmenta Server's WebSocket output in Unity

samples.description:
Contains a sample scene setting up the connection with a local Augmenta server and displaying the received data.
This sample uses the Visual Effect Graph package.
Contains a sample scene turning each tracked cluster into a small star system: a glowing core of its own color, a light, and planets orbiting around it.

Contains a sample scene turning the point cloud of each tracked cluster into a flowing cloud of particles, that fades in and out as people enter and leave.
This sample uses the Visual Effect Graph package.

Contains a sample scene where a single particle field covering the whole space is attracted and swirled by every tracked cluster, through a reusable Custom HLSL file.
This sample uses the Visual Effect Graph package.
